tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the AI tools GenCost tracks (video & avatar, image, voice, music), with each tool's cheapest paid plan in US dollars and whether it has a free plan.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Today's plans and prices for one AI tool (e.g. Runway, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Suno, HeyGen): monthly price, yearly price per month, credits, cost per video clip where known, hidden costs, and the date the prices were verified.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare the plans and prices of 2 to 6 AI tools side by side, in US dollars.

tools.name: find_cheapest
tools.description: Rank the AI tools in a category by their cheapest paid plan. For video, can rank by cost per clip instead.
